title: Large-volume snapshot compaction capacity
observations: The documented 2K volumetric procedural profile contains roughly 299,520 catalog pages across its LOD hierarchy.
The native snapshot path rejects this procedural catalog during snapshot-manifest validation before compaction.
The snapshot store also declares a separate 4,096-page source capacity, far below this profile's catalog size.
The same large world reopens successfully from its procedural source and durable edit journal, preserving committed authoritative samples.
The rejection is deterministic, explicit, and leaves no partially published output directory.
bounded_conclusion: Large-world durable journal save/load can be qualified independently of snapshot compaction.
Large-volume compacted snapshots are not qualified and must not be inferred from TQP-16 small-fixture compaction evidence.
No evidence attributes this limit to Transvoxel meshing tables or terrain geometry correctness.

disposition.TQP-27: Retain the deterministic capacity rejection as a required negative control and qualify only durable journal restart.
disposition.upstream: Replace or extend the bounded all-pages snapshot path before claiming compacted snapshots for the 2K volumetric profile.
disposition.production: Keep large-volume compaction unqualified until an upstream implementation passes equivalent large-world save, recovery, memory, and atomic-publication evidence.
